General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Door Latch Spacers.
These allow you to adjust your door correctly.
Sometimes it takes 2 per side to correctly the door. So I am including 4 Spacers in this set.
Suzuki OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Spacers, Door Latch
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
